🚨 CVE-2026-123082 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Docker Desktop before version 4.94.0 could write the signed-in user's Docker Hub access token (a JWT) in cleartext to application logs and diagnostics bundles. IPC payloads that were bare JSON strings or arrays were not redacted before logging, and a Docker Desktop component logged the token when it requested it from the backend. An attacker with read access to these files could obtain the token and use it to read an...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-123082
 
🚨 CVE-2026-126562 - Elastic
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Elastic
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 4.3
Resumo:
Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in the ElasticStore ConceptDescriptionInterpreter that only detects directly self-referencing concepts. Users with page-edit rights can create mutually referencing concept pages, causing concept page views, Special:Ask, or api.php action=ask queries to exhaust PHP memory or stack.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-126562

ExtractIPAddress in internal/auth/middleware.go supplied that value to IsAllowed and RecordFail...

🚨 CVE-2026-59986 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 7.4
Resumo:
rabbitmq-c is a C-language AMQP client library for RabbitMQ. Prior to version 0.17.0, the bounds check (*offset = o + len) <= encoded.len overflows when o + len > SIZE_MAX on 32-bit systems. len is a uint32_t read from the AMQP wire as a BYTES/UTF8 field length. The overflow wraps the check to a small value that passes, producing a decoded amqp_bytes_t with a multi-GB .len pointing into a small frame buffer. This res...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-59986
 
🚨 Critical Pre-Auth MongoDB Flaw (CVE-2026-118383) Can Crash Lagging Servers on Failover
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
A critical flaw in MongoDB Server allows an unauthenticated attacker to send two requests that trigger a crash on the database server. The crash occurs only if that server is later chosen to take over as the main server while it still lacks some recent changes. MongoDB, the company that makes the database, released fixed versions earlier this week. The affected servers are members of a replica
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/critical-pre-auth-mongodb-flaw-cve-2026.html
 
🚨 Critical Apache HTTP/2 Flaw Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Code Remotely
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 2.4
Resumo:
A critical flaw in Apache HTTP Server's HTTP/2 module, mod_http2, can let a remote attacker run code on the server. Tracked as CVE-2026-119618, it affects versions 2.4.55 through 2.4.70 and is fixed in version 2.4.71, released yesterday. Only servers with HTTP/2 enabled are affected, according to Red Hat, which ships the server as part of Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/critical-apache-http2-flaw-could-let.html
